checks: Wallet preserves exact-balance deductions, rejects negative mutations, keeps its balance on overflow, and serializes snapshots
Skill resource, cooldown, armor, recovery, and pending support state survive JsonUtility round-trip
Inventory item confirmation owns selection and commit state; discard affects only the selected stack, use delegates to gameplay rules, and stale/rejected actions preserve inventory
CombatHealth distinguishes one-shot threshold, alive, death, repeated damage, state-only revive and full respawn; respawn preserves the consumed special callback
Optional save snapshots recognize only top-level object values; absent/null, nested names and escaped string content cannot shadow legacy fields
Combined currency/item awards commit together; an invalid later item or balance overflow leaves every reward unchanged
Weapon transactions recheck and consume quotes once; purchase charges exact catalog price, while the selected sword cannot be sold
